logos.configuration.maxInjectedMana.tool: Largest :mana a single spell may inject (default 2147483647)

Maximum combined interpreter steps all spells may take per tick; beyond this limit, forms and delayed tasks defer to the next tick instead of expiring. Event-triggered actions cannot defer but still count toward the limit; lower this if active spells cause server lag
logos.configuration.maxFamiliars.tooltip: How many summoned familiars one player may have at once
logos.configuration.maxLifeforms.tooltip: How many mana lifeforms one player may have at once; summoning past it unmakes the oldest
logos.configuration.maxAnchors.tooltip: How many named anchors (^name) one player may keep
logos.configuration.incarnationHands.too: While incarnated as one of these creatures, a player can hold, use, and place items, mine, and cast; other creatures attack with their own body. Entity IDs, such as minecraft:zombie
logos.configuration.incarnationFliers.to: Creatures that fly without standard flight traits (no flying pathfinding or zero-gravity body); creatures with those traits can fly without being listed. Entity IDs
logos.configuration.voidIgnoresAbsorptio: When enabled, void damage bypasses absorption (spell shields, golden apples) and applies directly to health
logos.configuration.voidIgnoresTotem.too: When enabled, a Totem of Undying does not prevent death from void damage
logos.configuration.spellsLoadChunks.too: When disabled, spells never load chunks: projectiles, beams, and veins end before entering an unloaded chunk, and selectors and block runes find nothing there at no cost. When enabled, projectiles can travel their full lifetime (up to 1600 blocks) and spells can reach anywhere, loading or generating chunks on the server thread (which may lag busy servers). Blink always loads its destination regardless of this setting
logos.configuration.voidIsOutOfWorld.too: When enabled, void damage uses vanilla out-of-world damage with no attacker, and Execute behaves like /kill (affecting colossi as well). Creative players, invulnerable entities, and totems cannot prevent it, and kills grant no experience or kill credit
logos.configuration.fxNearDistance.toolt: Server: players within this distance of a persistent effect (projectile, beam, field, vein) receive every update; up to twice this distance they receive half, and beyond that a quarter. Start and end packets are always sent
logos.configuration.fxEffectsPerTick.too: Client: most burst-like effects started in one tick; the rest are skipped
logos.configuration.fxParticlesPerTick.t: Client: most particles spell effects add in one tick; the rest are skipped
logos.configuration.fxMaxTrails.tooltip: Client: most projectiles drawn at once; a new one waits for room
logos.configuration.fxMaxBeams.tooltip: Client: most lasting beams drawn at once; a new one waits for room
logos.configuration.fxMaxRays.tooltip: Client: most rays and beam wakes showing at once; a new one replaces the oldest
logos.configuration.fxMaxFields.tooltip: Client: most fields drawn at once; a new one waits for room
logos.configuration.fxMaxVeinHeads.toolt: Client: most vein heads drawn at once (a ring has up to 32); a new one waits for room
logos.configuration.runeUnlocks.tooltip: Server: when enabled, players can inscribe only the runes, elements, and motions they have learned (new players start with projectile, damage, physical, and forward). Creative players can inscribe anything, and found or given pages can always be cast and copied. When disabled, all runes are available to everyone
logos.configuration.giveGuideOnFirstJoin: Give the journal on first join
Server: grants each player one Logos Journal upon first joining. Players who joined while this option was disabled receive one once it is re-enabled
logos.configuration.spellTrace.tooltip: Server: sends the caster a chat summary after each spell showing how it ended, mana injected and remaining, and mana expenditure. Useful for building or testing spells; /logos trace on enables it for yourself only

logos.configuration.travelUnvisitedDimen: When enabled, in-dimension can target dimensions the caster has not visited; when disabled, the caster must visit them first (visits are always recorded)
Group damage/ignite/freeze pay this many times the single-target price, once, regardless of target count (default 3)

logos.configuration.maxGroupRadius.toolt: The furthest enemies, entities, players, items and marked search (default 64, and at most 64: entity searches reach no further)
logos.configuration.chargeMinTicks.toolt: A wand cast charges for at least this many ticks, however little it injects (default 5)
logos.configuration.timeSkipMaxRate.tool: The most ticks of day a time-skip pushes per game tick (default 720: an in-game day in under 2 seconds)
logos.configuration.timeSkipMaxRandomTic: The most a time-skip multiplies random ticks (crops, saplings, ice) in its dimension; costs the server in proportion, in every loaded chunk there (default 300)

logos.configuration.caputMortuumInsulati: Amount each block of caput mortuum adds to the spread threshold between its chunk and each neighbor; blocks on both sides count, up to 3 per chunk. At the default value of 70, two blocks completely block spread from a full chunk
logos.configuration.chargeManaScale.tool: Channel surge is multiplied by 1 + max mana / this: a deeper pool gathers faster (default 1000)
logos.configuration.maidManaPerFavorLeve: With Touhou Little Maid: a maid's mana cap is her owner's × (1 + this × favorability level 0–3) (default 0.1)
logos.configuration.growthXpWeight.toolt: Cap from experience ever gained: this × log2(1 + points / scale) (default 150)

logos.configuration.growthPracticeWeight: Cap from mana ever spent: this × log2(1 + mana / scale) (default 100)

logos.configuration.overflowDrain.toolti: When the mana cap drops below current mana, this fraction of the surplus drains per second, with a minimum of 1 (default 0.05)

logos.editor.context.title: Context wire: %s
logos.editor.context.static: These are the meanings at each use; actual entities and coordinates depend on runtime events.
logos.editor.context.unused: No use reachable from the invocation was found. Check the downstream actions and flow connections.
logos.editor.context.multiple: This wire has several uses; their meanings are listed separately.
logos.editor.context.recursive: The spell contains recursion: re-entry inherits the calling context, so the listed sources may be incomplete.
logos.editor.context.incomplete: A connection cycle or analysis limit prevents a complete list of sources.
logos.editor.context.meaning.caster: The caster of this spell; nested forms and iteration do not replace it.
logos.editor.context.meaning.emitter_cas: The spell emitter's proxy caster representing its owner.
logos.editor.context.meaning.cast_positi: The invocation position, usually the caster's eyes at casting; another casting entry point may supply a position.
logos.editor.context.meaning.attack_posi: For player attack triggers, the victim's center; familiar passive casting normally starts at the familiar's eyes.
logos.editor.context.meaning.kill_positi: For player kill triggers, the killed entity's center; familiar passive casting normally starts at the familiar's eyes.
logos.editor.context.meaning.cast_target: A target supplied by the casting entry point; ordinary manual player casts provide none.
logos.editor.context.meaning.hurt_target: The attacker that triggered the hurt invocation; some damage sources provide no entity.
logos.editor.context.meaning.attack_targ: The victim that triggered the attack invocation.
logos.editor.context.meaning.kill_target: The entity whose death triggered the kill invocation.
logos.editor.context.meaning.cast_aim: The caster's facing direction when this cast started.
logos.editor.context.meaning.up: The fixed upward direction, unchanged by events.
logos.editor.context.meaning.down: The fixed downward direction, unchanged by events.
logos.editor.context.meaning.no_self: No construct context is available here.
logos.editor.context.meaning.zero_index: No repeat body has been entered; the index is initially 0.
logos.editor.context.meaning.repeat_inde: The innermost repeat iteration, starting at 0; inner repeats replace the outer index.
logos.editor.context.meaning.split_aim: The deflected direction calculated by split for this branch.
logos.editor.context.meaning.each_positi: The center of the current entity in the each body.
logos.editor.context.meaning.each_target: The entity currently processed by the each body.
logos.editor.context.meaning.block_posit: The current block's position and dimension in the each-block body.
logos.editor.context.meaning.projectile_: The projectile's position when the event fired, or its final position on expiry.
The projectile's collision point on the entity, rather than the entity's center.
The projectile's travel direction when the event fired.
logos.editor.context.meaning.hit_target: The entity hit in this hit event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.impact_bloc: The center of the block blocking the ray, beam, projectile or vein.
logos.editor.context.meaning.field_posit: The field's center at this event, or its final center on expiry.
logos.editor.context.meaning.vein_head: The vein's leading tip on the ground at this event, its final position on expiry, or the origin of a spreading ring.
logos.editor.context.meaning.vein_contac: The point on the ground under the entity the vein touched.
logos.editor.context.meaning.vein_step: The center of the block the vein just stepped onto (including wall or ceiling blocks when climbing).
logos.editor.context.meaning.vein_aim: The horizontal direction the vein was traveling at this event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.enter_targe: The entity that triggered this entry event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.entity_cent: The center and dimension of the entity bound by this event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.beam_end: The beam endpoint at this event, including truncation by obstacles.
logos.editor.context.meaning.beam_aim: The beam's direction at this event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.ray_end: The final endpoint of this instantaneous ray.
logos.editor.context.meaning.ray_aim: The direction of this ray from its origin toward its endpoint.
logos.editor.context.meaning.construct_p: The construct's center at this event, or its last recorded position on expiry.
logos.editor.context.meaning.construct_c: The interaction position: entity center for blocking a creature, feet when standing, or projectile contact point.
logos.editor.context.meaning.construct_s: The construct entity of the innermost construct event; nested non-construct events inherit it.
logos.editor.context.meaning.form_self: The spell form (projectile, beam, vein, construct, field, or mana wrap) of the innermost form event; nested events that create no form inherit it.
logos.editor.context.meaning.no_form: Not inside any form's events, so there is no form here; after a form, wire its 'this form' output instead.
logos.editor.context.meaning.construct_n: The surface normal provided by this construct event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.construct_t: The entity blocked, supported or admitted by this construct event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.pass_positi: The passing creature's center, or the projectile's crossing point.
logos.editor.context.meaning.pass_aim: The movement direction of the passing entity or projectile.
logos.editor.context.meaning.killed_targ: The entity killed by the effect that triggered this kill event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.wrap_self: The creature bound by the innermost mana wrap (the weapon wielder); nested non-wrap events inherit it.
logos.editor.context.meaning.wrap_positi: The wrapped creature's center; its eyes in a swing event.
logos.editor.context.meaning.wrap_contac: The point of impact: the target's center for a melee hit, or the impact point for an arrow or trident.
logos.editor.context.meaning.wrap_aim: From the wielder's eyes to the target for a melee hit, the flight direction for an arrow or trident, or the wrapped creature's facing direction on swing, pulse, and expiry.
logos.editor.context.meaning.unknown: This event's context rules are not covered by static analysis yet.

logos.desc.spell.intro: The entry point of a spell, setting its name, mana budget, and invocation trigger. Only one may exist in each spell graph.
logos.desc.spell.param.name: Names the spell so pages and cast reports can tell it apart.
logos.desc.spell.param.mana: Total mana requested for a cast, shared across all nodes, summoned forms, and delayed actions; the page's capacity limits how much is actually injected.
logos.desc.spell.param.trigger: Sets whether the spell is cast actively or triggered automatically when the caster is hurt, attacks, or kills.
logos.desc.spell.param.players: Allows the spell to affect players other than the caster; off by default.
logos.desc.spell.param.immolate: Allows a wand enchanted with Formula Immolation to exceed the page's mana capacity and burn the page in the process; applies to both active and passive casts.
logos.desc.spell.param.intent: Declares the spell's purpose so Mana Lifeforms know when to cast it; inferred automatically from the runes when set to Infer.
logos.desc.spell.param.reach_self: Lets a heal, ward, or empower spell target the caster themselves. When all three reach boxes are unchecked, reach is inferred from the targets inside the spell.
logos.desc.spell.param.reach_one: Lets a heal, ward, or empower spell target a single ally, such as the caster's owner. Inferred automatically when all three reach boxes are unchecked.
logos.desc.spell.param.reach_group: Lets a heal, ward, or empower spell affect a group at once. Inferred automatically when all three reach boxes are unchecked.
logos.desc.spell.param.start: Connects to the first action executed when the spell runs.
logos.desc.emitter.intro: Replaces the spell invocation node while editing a page inside a Spell Emitter, setting the spell name, mana injection, and emitter trigger. Saving restores an active cast-at-will invocation on the page so it can still be hung on a wand.
logos.desc.emitter.param.name: Names the spell so pages and cast records can identify it.
logos.desc.emitter.param.mana: Mana injected per cast from the emitter's reserve; capped by the page's capacity, as emitters cannot use Formula Immolation.
logos.desc.emitter.param.players: Allows the emitted spell to affect players other than the emitter's owner; off by default.
logos.desc.emitter.param.mode: Redstone pulse: casts once per redstone pulse; Redstone held: casts whenever fully charged while powered; Timed: casts every set number of seconds; When full: casts as soon as full. Timed and When full trigger automatically and cost 2 extra mana per cast.
logos.desc.emitter.param.interval: Seconds between casts in Timed mode (1–3600); unused in other modes.
logos.desc.emitter.param.start: Connects to the first action executed on each cast. Inside the cast, here is the emitter's center, aim is the direction it faces, and caster is a proxy for its owner.
logos.desc.projectile.intro: Launches a magical projectile along a chosen motion path. The projectile handles flight and collision; damage and other effects come from its event outputs.
logos.desc.projectile.note: Deploys for 4 mana plus any extra cost from the chosen motion. Deals no damage on its own; wire damage, ignite, or other effects to its events.
logos.desc.projectile.param.from: Starting position of the projectile; defaults to here.
logos.desc.projectile.param.dir: Initial flight direction; defaults to aim.
logos.desc.projectile.param.speed: Travel speed along the path. Range: 0.1–4; default: 1.2. Different motions use speed differently.
logos.desc.projectile.param.life: Maximum lifetime of the projectile. Range: 0.1–20 s; default: 3 s.
logos.desc.projectile.param.motion: Trajectory such as forward, arc, homing, wander, boomerang, or orbit; defaults to forward.
logos.desc.projectile.param.pierce: Number of additional entities the projectile can pass through after hitting one. Range: 0–99; default: 0, dispersing on the first hit.
logos.desc.projectile.param.size: Controls both the visual scale and collision hitbox of the projectile. Range: 0.1–3; default: 0.3.
logos.desc.projectile.param.look: Displays the projectile using the model of a specified item or creature facing the direction of flight; scales with Size and only changes appearance, never flight or damage.
logos.desc.projectile.param.spin: Model rotations per second around its axis. Range: -10 to 10; sign controls direction; default: 0.
logos.desc.projectile.param.trail: Custom particle emitted behind the projectile; leave blank to use the element's default trail.
logos.desc.projectile.param.on-hit: Runs when the projectile hits an entity; target is the struck entity and here is its center.
logos.desc.projectile.param.on-impact: Runs when the projectile strikes a block; here is the struck block's position.
logos.desc.projectile.param.on-tick: Runs every game tick while the projectile exists; here moves with the projectile.
logos.desc.projectile.param.on-expire: Runs when the projectile disperses due to lifetime expiry, block impact, or exhausting pierces; here is its final position. Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.projectile.param.yield: Outputs this projectile form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.beam.intro: Sustains a beam with thickness that periodically triggers hit and pulse events. Stops against solid blocks and blocking constructs.
logos.desc.beam.note: Deploys for 6 mana, plus 0.3 + 0.05 * radius * range per pulse. Deals no damage on its own.
logos.desc.beam.param.from: Origin of the beam. Leave unwired to follow the caster's eyes continuously; when wired, re-reads that input each tick.
logos.desc.beam.param.dir: Direction of the beam. Leave unwired to follow the caster's gaze continuously; when wired, re-reads that input each tick.
logos.desc.beam.param.radius: Collision radius of the beam. Range: 0.1–4 blocks; default: 0.5 blocks.
logos.desc.beam.param.range: Maximum length when unobstructed. Range: 1–64 blocks; default: 24 blocks.
logos.desc.beam.param.life: Maximum duration of the beam. Range: 0.05–30 s; default: 2 s.
logos.desc.beam.param.every: Interval between beam pulses. Range: 0.05–10 s; default: 0.25 s; governs how often hit actions run.
logos.desc.beam.param.trail: Extra particle displayed along the beam; does not change hit detection or pulse timing.
logos.desc.beam.param.on-enter: Runs when an entity enters the beam; target is the entering entity and here is its center. Can trigger again if the entity leaves and re-enters.
logos.desc.beam.param.on-hit: Runs on each pulse for every entity inside the beam; target is the current entity and here is its center.
logos.desc.beam.param.on-tick: Runs once per pulse; here is the beam's endpoint at that moment.
logos.desc.beam.param.on-impact: Runs on any pulse where the beam is blocked by a solid block; here is the blocking block's position.
logos.desc.beam.param.on-expire: Runs when the beam disperses; here is its final endpoint. Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.beam.param.yield: Outputs this beam form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.vein.intro: Sends a crawling vein across the ground, like spreading vines, ground fire, earthbound sword waves, or erupting frost spikes. Can step up 1-block ledges, follow drops up to 4 blocks, and travel across liquids.
logos.desc.vein.note: Costs 4 + motion cost (forward 0, wander/snake/sweep 1, ring 2, homing 3) + 0.05 * width * height * path length (usually range; for ring, max(range, range * pi * angle / 360); for sweep, radius * angle in radians). Fails without costing mana if no ground lies within 6 blocks below. Deals no damage on its own.
logos.desc.vein.param.from: Searches downward up to 6 blocks from here to find starting ground; in sweep mode, serves as the arc center while the vein begins on the arc itself. Defaults to here.
logos.desc.vein.param.dir: Horizontal travel direction, or centerline for ring and sweep arcs. Falls back to the caster's facing direction when pointing straight up or down. Defaults to aim.
logos.desc.vein.param.motion: Crawling motion (uses Motion runes). Shared with projectiles: forward, homing toward the nearest enemy, or wander (turning randomly within 60 degrees). Exclusive to veins: snake waves side-to-side, ring expands outward in a full circle or fan, and sweep arcs around the origin. Arc, orbit, and boomerang fail validation.
logos.desc.vein.param.spread: Total angular span in degrees for ring and sweep motions, centered on Direction. Range: 1–360; default: 360.
logos.desc.vein.param.radius: Arc radius for sweep motion. Range: 0.5–32 blocks; default: 3 blocks.
logos.desc.vein.param.ccw: Makes sweep travel counter-clockwise when viewed from above. Default is clockwise, sweeping left to right when centered on the caster.
logos.desc.vein.param.linger: Leaves an active trail along the crawled path for up to 30 seconds (0 disables lingering). Entities touching the trail trigger On hit once per entity without consuming pierce counts, and the trail fades from oldest to newest before expiry. Adds 0.02 * width * height * length * seconds mana; wire Construct to On step for physical barriers.
logos.desc.vein.param.climb: Allows the vein to cling to any block surface: climbs up walls, crosses ceilings, and wraps around ledges and cliff edges without falling off. Travels straight across open gaps until reattaching to a surface.
logos.desc.vein.param.speed: Crawl distance per tick. Range: 0.1–2 blocks/tick; default: 0.6.
logos.desc.vein.param.range: Maximum crawl distance, or expansion radius for ring. Range: 1–64 blocks; default: 16 blocks. Ignored by sweep, which crawls the entire arc.
logos.desc.vein.param.width: Horizontal collision width for hitting entities. Range: 0.25–4 blocks; default: 1 block.
logos.desc.vein.param.height: Collision height above the ground. Range: 0.25–4 blocks; default: 1 block.
logos.desc.vein.param.pierce: Number of additional entities the vein can pass through after hitting one; default: 0, stopping at the first hit. Each entity can only be struck once.
logos.desc.vein.param.on-hit: Runs when touching an entity, including via a lingering trail; target is the struck entity and here is the ground point beneath its feet.
logos.desc.vein.param.on-step: Runs each time the vein advances onto a new surface block, including the starting block (ring triggers once per origin step, and climbing includes wall or ceiling blocks); here is that block's center, useful for setting fire, freezing, or growing along the path.
logos.desc.vein.param.on-impact: Runs when blocked by an un-climbable wall; here is the blocking block. Each branch of a ring triggers independently.
logos.desc.vein.param.on-expire: Runs when the vein finishes its range, expires, hits a wall, exhausts pierces, or loses ground; when lingering, waits until the entire trail fades. Here is the final position (or the origin for ring). Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.vein.param.yield: Outputs this vein form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.construct.intro: Shapes a solid arcane construct that can block, support, or carry entities as a box, wall, platform, shield disk, or dome, firing events on contact and movement.
logos.desc.construct.note: Use the self context node inside construct events to reference the structure. Costs 4 + 0.3 * area (or volume for boxes) to form, 0.2 + 0.02 * area per second to sustain, and 0.5 mana per block event. Its durability equals twice the formation cost and shatters when depleted by hits.
logos.desc.construct.param.shape: Selects Box, Wall, Platform, Disk, or Dome; defaults to Wall. Only dimensions used by the chosen shape are shown unless computed dynamically, and Disk adds a magic circle toggle.
logos.desc.construct.param.at: Initial center position of the construct; defaults to 3 blocks ahead of here along aim.
logos.desc.construct.param.facing: Orientation of a wall or shield disk; defaults to aim.
logos.desc.construct.param.width: Horizontal width for boxes, walls, and platforms. Range: 0.5–16 blocks; default: 5 blocks.
logos.desc.construct.param.height: Vertical height for boxes and walls. Range: 0.5–16 blocks; default: 3 blocks.
logos.desc.construct.param.depth: Front-to-back thickness for boxes and platforms. Range: 0.5–16 blocks; default: 1 block.
logos.desc.construct.param.radius: Radius for disks and domes. Range: 0.5–8 blocks; default: 3 blocks. Unused by rectangular shapes.
logos.desc.construct.param.life: Maximum lifetime of the construct. Range: 0.5–120 s; default: 10 s. Also disperses if mana runs out or the structure shatters.
logos.desc.construct.param.every: Interval between On pulse events. Range: 0.05–10 s; default: 1 s.
logos.desc.construct.param.solid: Filter choosing which entities the construct blocks; defaults to all entities including the caster. Connect a filter to let chosen targets pass through.
logos.desc.construct.param.look: Renders the construct using the chosen block's appearance; purely visual and never alters collision rules.
logos.desc.construct.param.to: Optional movement destination upon creation. Leave blank to stay stationary until commanded later by move.
logos.desc.construct.param.speed: Travel speed toward the destination. Range: 0.01–2 blocks/tick; default: 0.2. Entities standing on the construct are carried along.
logos.desc.construct.param.snap: Aligns placement coordinates to the block grid for cleaner building and footing.
logos.desc.construct.param.one-way: Blocks only from the front side (from above for platforms, from outside for domes).
logos.desc.construct.param.deflect: Reflects colliding projectiles back instead of merely stopping them.
logos.desc.construct.param.follow: Moves with the caster; walls and shield disks also rotate with the caster's gaze.
logos.desc.construct.param.sigil: Renders a disk construct as counter-rotating elemental magic circles instead of alchemical glass (brighter when one-way blocking is enabled). Visual only; shown only for the Disk shape.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-block: Runs when blocking an entity or projectile; target is the blocked object and here is the contact point. Continuous contact can re-trigger after a short cooldown.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-stand: Runs when an entity steps onto the construct; target is the standing entity and here is the contact point.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-pass: Runs when an admitted creature or projectile passes through; target is the passing object, here is the creature's center or projectile crossing point, and aim is its movement direction.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-arrive: Runs when the construct reaches its destination; here is the construct's center.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-tick: Runs on each pulse interval; here is the construct's center.
logos.desc.construct.param.on-expire: Runs when the construct disperses; here is its final center. Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.construct.param.yield: Outputs this construct form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.field.intro: Maintains a spherical area that detects entering creatures and executes actions periodically. Deals no damage on its own.
logos.desc.field.note: Deploys for 6 mana and costs 0.5 mana per pulse.
logos.desc.field.param.at: Initial center of the field; defaults to here.
logos.desc.field.param.radius: Detection radius of the field. Range: 0.5–16 blocks; default: 3 blocks.
logos.desc.field.param.life: Maximum duration of the field. Range: 0.05–30 s; default: 4 s.
logos.desc.field.param.every: Interval between pulses. Range: 0.05–10 s; default: 0.5 s.
logos.desc.field.param.follow: Makes the field's center continuously follow roughly 1 block above the caster's position.
logos.desc.field.param.on-tick: Runs once per pulse; here is the field's center. Wire area selectors here to act on entities inside the field.
logos.desc.field.param.on-enter: Runs when a creature enters the field, including the caster; target is the entering creature and here is its center. Can trigger again if it leaves and re-enters.
logos.desc.field.param.on-expire: Runs when the field disperses; here is its final center. Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.field.param.yield: Outputs this field form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.ray.intro: Casts an instantaneous ray that resolves along-the-path hits and its endpoint in a single step, ideal for immediate ranged effects.
logos.desc.ray.note: Costs 3 mana to cast; wire hit and impact effects to its events.
logos.desc.ray.param.from: Origin of the ray; defaults to here.
logos.desc.ray.param.dir: Direction of the ray when no target override is wired; defaults to aim.
logos.desc.ray.param.to: Optional target entity override. When wired, aims straight at that entity's center, overriding Direction and normal range tracing; if the entity is missing, no ray is cast.
logos.desc.ray.param.range: Maximum trace distance when no target override is set. Range: 1–64 blocks; default: 16 blocks. Stops against solid blocks or blocking constructs.
logos.desc.ray.param.pierce: Number of additional entities hit along the ray after the first when tracing without a target override. Range: 0–99; default: 0.
logos.desc.ray.param.on-hit: Runs when hitting an entity; target is the struck entity and here is its center.
logos.desc.ray.param.on-impact: Runs when an untargeted ray is stopped by a block; here is the blocking block's position.
logos.desc.ray.param.on-expire: Runs immediately at the ray's endpoint; here is that endpoint.
logos.desc.split.intro: Fans out the connected action across multiple directions in an arc or full circle. Each copy runs with its own deflected aim direction.
logos.desc.split.note: Costs 2 mana per copy created; inner actions pay their own costs.
logos.desc.split.param.count: Total number of copies to execute (minimum 1, capped by config); not added on top of an existing shot.
logos.desc.split.param.spread: Total angular span covered across all copies. Range: 0–360 degrees; default: 30 degrees. At 360 degrees, copies distribute around a full circle.
logos.desc.split.param.body: Action executed for each deflected direction; use the aim context node inside to read that branch's direction.
logos.desc.nearest.intro: Finds the closest enemy within range.
logos.desc.nearest.result: The nearest matching enemy, or empty if none is found.
logos.desc.nearest.note: Costs 1 mana per evaluation, even if nothing is found. Excludes the caster, allies, and the caster's familiars; targeting other players also requires Affect players on the spell.
logos.desc.nearest.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.nearest.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 10 blocks.
logos.desc.nearest.param.filter: Optional filter applied on top of valid enemies; leave unwired for no extra restriction.
logos.desc.nearest.param.fresh: Excludes entities already affected by this spell, helping prevent chains from bouncing back onto the same target.
logos.desc.enemies.intro: Gathers enemies within range for group effects or iteration.
logos.desc.enemies.result: Entity group containing all matching enemies, carrying the search radius for group-cost pricing.
logos.desc.enemies.note: Costs 2 mana per evaluation, even if nothing is found. Excludes the caster, allies, and the caster's familiars; targeting other players also requires Affect players on the spell.
logos.desc.enemies.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.enemies.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 5 blocks.
logos.desc.enemies.param.filter: Optional filter applied on top of valid enemies; leave unwired for no extra restriction.
logos.desc.enemies.param.fresh: Excludes entities already affected by this spell, preventing chains from repeating on the same targets.
logos.desc.players.intro: Finds living players within range other than the caster, excluding spectators.
logos.desc.players.result: Entity group containing matching other players.
logos.desc.players.note: Costs 1 mana per evaluation, even if no player is found. Requires Affect players to be enabled on the spell.
logos.desc.players.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.players.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 8 blocks.
logos.desc.nearest-player.intro: Finds the closest living player other than the caster within range, excluding spectators.
logos.desc.nearest-player.result: The nearest other player, or empty if none is found or Affect players is off.
logos.desc.nearest-player.note: Costs 1 mana per evaluation even if no one is found, but returns empty at no cost when Affect players is off. When triggered inside a field with Affect players enabled, the caster is also eligible.
logos.desc.nearest-player.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.nearest-player.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 10 blocks.
logos.desc.nearest-player.param.fresh: Excludes players already affected by this spell, preventing chain effects from hitting the same player repeatedly.
logos.desc.entities.intro: Finds entities matching a filter within range, including creatures, projectiles, dropped items, and the caster.
logos.desc.entities.result: Entity group of matching entities, carrying the search radius.
logos.desc.entities.note: Costs 2 mana per evaluation, even if nothing is found.
logos.desc.entities.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.entities.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 6 blocks.
logos.desc.entities.param.filter: Optional filter restricting which entities are selected; leave blank for no extra restriction.
logos.desc.items.intro: Finds dropped item entities within range for pulling, gathering, or counting.
logos.desc.items.result: Entity group of matching dropped items.
logos.desc.items.note: Costs 1 mana per evaluation, even if no items are found.
logos.desc.items.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.items.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 6 blocks.
logos.desc.items.param.filter: Keeps only matching dropped items by item registry ID or #tag; leave blank for all items.
logos.desc.blocks.intro: Finds non-air blocks within a radius around a center position.
logos.desc.blocks.result: Set of matching block positions for each-block or block effects.
logos.desc.blocks.note: Costs 2 mana per evaluation, even if no matching blocks are found.
logos.desc.blocks.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.blocks.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 2 blocks, maximum: 8 blocks.
logos.desc.blocks.param.filter: Keeps only blocks matching a block registry ID or #tag; leave blank to include all non-air blocks.
logos.desc.marked.intro: Finds enemies within range carrying a specific status or mark.
logos.desc.marked.note: Costs 1 mana per evaluation, even if nothing is found. Excludes the caster, allies, and the caster's familiars; targeting other players also requires Affect players on the spell.
logos.desc.marked.param.at: Center of the search; defaults to here.
logos.desc.marked.param.radius: Search radius around the center; default: 24 blocks.
logos.desc.marked.param.mark: Status or mark to look for: burning, frozen, or a custom mark name matching the one applied with mark.
logos.desc.kind.intro: Creates a filter matching a category of entities; does not search the world by itself.
logos.desc.kind.result: Entity filter ready to connect to area selectors or condition checks like is.
logos.desc.kind.param.kind: Target kind such as enemies, projectiles, or items; may also receive the output of species to match an exact creature registry ID. An empty input matches nothing.
logos.desc.species.intro: Identifies an entity's creature type by reading its registry ID.
logos.desc.species.param.entity: Entity to inspect, such as caster, target, familiar, or another single entity.
logos.desc.species.result: That entity's species kind; wiring it to kind creates a filter matching only that exact creature type.
logos.desc.species.note: Costs no mana. Works with both vanilla and modded creatures; inspects species rather than faction. When the input entity is empty, the resulting filter matches nothing.
logos.desc.any-of.intro: Combines multiple filters so an object passes if it matches at least one.
logos.desc.any-of.result: Union filter matching objects accepted by any connected filter.
logos.desc.any-of.param.argument-count: Sets how many filter inputs are combined, adding or removing filter ports accordingly.
logos.desc.any-of.param.filter: One of the filters tested; matching any single one admits the entity or block.
logos.desc.all-of.intro: Combines multiple filters so an object passes only if it matches every one.
logos.desc.all-of.result: Intersection filter matching only objects accepted by all connected filters.
logos.desc.all-of.param.argument-count: Sets how many filter inputs are combined, adding or removing filter ports accordingly.
logos.desc.all-of.param.filter: One of the filters tested; the entity or block must satisfy every filter to pass.
logos.desc.except.intro: Excludes unwanted matches from another filter.
logos.desc.except.result: Combined filter accepting objects that pass Filter and fail Excluded filter.
logos.desc.except.param.without: Exclusion filter; matching candidates are rejected even if they pass the base filter.
logos.desc.familiar.intro: Retrieves one of the caster's owned familiars.
logos.desc.familiar.result: The matching owned familiar, or empty if none is found or the caster is not a player.
logos.desc.familiar.param.name: Name given when summoning the familiar; leave blank to select the most recently summoned one.
logos.desc.hit-list.intro: Retrieves all entities already affected during this spell cast for chaining or exclusion.
logos.desc.hit-list.result: Living entities affected by this spell so far; excludes mere collisions that applied no effect.
logos.desc.master.intro: Retrieves the caster's owner so a familiar or lifeform can cast spells for them.
logos.desc.master.result: The familiar's owning player; returns the caster itself if it has no owner, or empty if the owner is offline or not in a loaded world.
logos.desc.foe.intro: Retrieves the target a casting creature is currently attacking or ordered to fight.
logos.desc.foe.result: Current hostile target, or empty when idle or when the caster is a player.
logos.desc.pos-of.intro: Reads the position and dimension of an entity or spell form.
logos.desc.pos-of.result: The entity's center, or the form's position (a projectile's current location, a construct's or field's center, or a beam's origin); falls back to here if empty.
logos.desc.pos-of.param.entity: Entity or form whose position to read, such as caster, target, familiar, 'this form', or a form node's 'this form' output.
logos.desc.dir-of.intro: Reads the facing or travel direction of an entity or spell form.
logos.desc.dir-of.result: The entity's gaze, the projectile's velocity, the beam's direction, the construct's front face (upward for platforms), or upward for fields; falls back to aim if empty.
logos.desc.dir-of.param.of: Entity or form whose direction to read.
logos.desc.dir-of.note: Costs no mana. Pairing this with turn lets one form mirror another's orientation.
logos.desc.above.intro: Offsets a position vertically upward or downward.
logos.desc.above.result: Position keeping the original dimension and horizontal coordinates with an adjusted height.
logos.desc.above.param.height: Vertical offset in blocks; default: 8. Positive moves up, negative moves down.
logos.desc.ahead.intro: Steps a given distance forward from an origin along a direction.
logos.desc.ahead.result: Offset position in the same dimension as the origin.
logos.desc.ahead.param.distance: Distance to offset along Direction in blocks; negative values step backward.
logos.desc.ahead.param.dir: Normalized travel direction; defaults to aim.
logos.desc.offset.intro: Computes a point relative to an origin using forward, up, and right offsets. Ideal for Spell Emitters targeting nearby blocks so rotating or relocating a setup needs no rewiring; Dividers can paste measured offsets in one click.
logos.desc.offset.result: Offset position in the same dimension as the origin.
logos.desc.offset.param.forward: Blocks forward along the horizontal component of Direction (negative moves backward). For vertical emitters facing straight up or down, south serves as forward.
logos.desc.offset.param.up: Blocks upward along the vertical axis regardless of pitch; default: 0. Negative moves downward.
logos.desc.offset.param.right: Blocks to the right; default: 0. Negative moves to the left.
logos.desc.offset.param.from: Origin for the calculation; defaults to here.
logos.desc.offset.param.dir: Direction defining forward; defaults to aim.
logos.desc.spot.intro: Samples a random position uniformly inside a volume or within an existing form, rolling a new point on each evaluation.
logos.desc.spot.result: Sampled position in the same dimension as the center or form.
logos.desc.spot.param.at: Center of the sampling region when no form is connected; defaults to here.
logos.desc.spot.param.radius: Size of the sampling region when no form is connected; default: 4 blocks (radius for spheres and disks, half-extent for cubes).
logos.desc.spot.param.in: Optional spell form to sample within, overriding Center, Radius, and Shape. Samples the sphere or circle face for fields, the exact geometry for constructs (walls, platforms, disks, domes, or boxes), or the form's position for other forms; defaults to here if empty.
logos.desc.spot.param.shape: Sampling volume when no form is connected: Ball, Horizontal disk, or Cube.
logos.desc.spot.param.where: Inside picks any point within the volume; Surface picks the outer shell, disk rim, cube faces, or a field's magic circle plane.
logos.desc.spot.param.ground: Drops the sampled point to the nearest standable block in the same vertical column, useful for summoning or blinking; keeps the original position if none exists.
logos.desc.mix-pos.intro: Interpolates along the line segment between two positions: Ratio 0 yields Point A, 1 yields Point B, and 0.5 yields the midpoint.
logos.desc.mix-pos.result: Interpolated position in the same dimension as Point A. Ratios below 0 extend beyond Point A and ratios above 1 extend beyond Point B along the same line.
logos.desc.mix-pos.param.a: Start position at Ratio 0; also determines the output dimension.
logos.desc.mix-pos.param.alpha: Interpolation ratio along the segment; pair with the loop index i to arrange points evenly, or with random to pick randomly along the line.
logos.desc.look-point.intro: Finds the open position the caster is looking at, useful for summoning or placing effects just in front of a surface.
logos.desc.look-point.result: Air position directly in front of the struck block face, or the end of the line of sight if nothing is hit.
logos.desc.look-point.param.range: Maximum trace distance along the caster's gaze; default: 32 blocks.
logos.desc.look-block.intro: Finds the block the caster is looking at, useful for feeding into block effects.
logos.desc.look-block.result: Center of the struck block, or the end of the line of sight if nothing is hit.
logos.desc.look-block.param.range: Maximum trace distance along the caster's gaze; default: 32 blocks.
logos.desc.in-dimension.intro: Maps a position to its corresponding coordinates in another dimension without teleporting anything.
logos.desc.in-dimension.result: Mapped position in the target dimension, scaled by coordinate ratio horizontally and clamped within the world's buildable height.
logos.desc.in-dimension.note: Costs 2 mana. Extinguishes the spell if the dimension does not exist or has not been visited yet.
logos.desc.in-dimension.param.dimension: Target dimension; must already have been visited by the caster or their owner unless unvisited travel is enabled.
logos.desc.in-dimension.param.pos: Position to convert; defaults to here.
logos.desc.toward.intro: Computes the direction vector pointing from one position toward another.
logos.desc.toward.result: Unit direction vector from Origin to Destination; compares coordinates directly without cross-dimensional mapping.
logos.desc.random-dir.intro: Produces a random unit direction vector in 3D space for scatter or erratic motion.
logos.desc.random-dir.result: Random unit direction rolled freshly on each evaluation.
logos.desc.damage.intro: Deals elemental damage to one or more living targets.
logos.desc.damage.note: Mana cost per point of damage varies by element.
logos.desc.damage.param.target: Living creature or entity group to damage; group members are damaged and paid for individually.
logos.desc.damage.param.amount: Base damage dealt to each target; values below 0 are treated as 0.
logos.desc.damage.param.element: Damage element; defaults to Physical. Governs damage properties and mana cost.
logos.desc.damage.param.on-kill: Runs when this damage kills a target; target is the slain creature and here is its center.
logos.desc.drain.intro: Steals health with Void damage, healing the caster for half the amount dealt.
logos.desc.drain.note: Costs 1.5 mana per point of drain damage.
logos.desc.drain.param.target: Living creature or entity group to drain; group members are affected and paid for individually.
logos.desc.drain.param.amount: Drain damage dealt to each target; restores half that amount of health to the caster.
logos.desc.drain.param.on-kill: Runs when this damage kills a target; target is the slain creature and here is its center.
logos.desc.heal.note: Costs 1.5 mana per point of healing.
logos.desc.heal.param.target: Living creature or entity group to heal; group members are healed and paid for individually.
logos.desc.heal.param.amount: Health restored to each target, capped at its maximum health.
logos.desc.shield.intro: Grants temporary absorption shielding to living targets.
logos.desc.shield.note: Costs 1.5 mana per point of shielding.
logos.desc.shield.param.target: Living creature or entity group to shield; group members are shielded and paid for individually.
logos.desc.shield.param.amount: Absorption points added to each target, stacking with existing shielding.
logos.desc.infuse.intro: Transfers mana from this spell cast into players, Mana Lifeforms, or Alchemical Colossi.
logos.desc.infuse.note: Costs 1.1 mana per 1 mana transferred. Transfers only what still fits in the target's reserve; full or non-magical targets are unaffected and cost nothing. Giving mana to other players requires Affect players on the spell.
logos.desc.infuse.param.target: Mana-capable creature (player, Mana Lifeform, or Alchemical Colossus) or entity group; each eligible target is infused and paid for individually.
logos.desc.infuse.param.amount: Maximum mana transferred to each target; excess beyond capacity is not spent.
logos.desc.ignite.intro: Sets entities ablaze, including arrows in flight.
logos.desc.ignite.note: Costs 0.6 mana per second per target.
logos.desc.ignite.param.target: Entity or entity group to ignite (creatures, items, or projectiles); each is ignited and paid for individually.
logos.desc.ignite.param.seconds: Burn duration. Range: 0–60 s. Burning arrows set struck targets on fire.
logos.desc.freeze.intro: Freezes living targets, sharply slowing their movement.
logos.desc.freeze.note: Costs 1.2 mana per second per target.
logos.desc.freeze.param.target: Living creature or entity group to freeze; each is frozen and paid for individually.
logos.desc.freeze.param.seconds: Freeze duration. Range: 0–30 s. Reapplying keeps whichever expiry time is later rather than stacking durations.
logos.desc.time-stop.intro: Freezes targets completely in time: creatures hang motionless midair with AI, burning, and potion timers paused, while players can only rotate their view and cannot move, jump, attack, use items, or interact.
logos.desc.time-stop.note: Costs 4 mana per second per target. Damage dealt while stopped is queued and resolved blow-by-blow when time resumes, evaluating armor per hit without blocking subsequent hits with invulnerability frames. Unblockable damage such as void or /kill still applies immediately. Fatal deferred damage does not trigger the spell's kill events, and mounted creatures cannot be stopped.
logos.desc.time-stop.param.target: Living creature, player, or entity group to freeze in time; each is stopped and paid for individually.
logos.desc.time-stop.param.seconds: Freeze duration. Range: 0–10 s. Reapplying extends expiry to whichever end time is later without losing queued damage.
logos.desc.glow.intro: Outlines targets with the glowing effect for easy visibility.
logos.desc.glow.note: Costs 0.2 mana per second per target.
logos.desc.glow.param.target: Entity or entity group to outline, including dropped items; each is affected and paid for individually.
logos.desc.damage-all.intro: Deals elemental damage across an entire entity group at once.
logos.desc.damage-all.note: Charges a flat group fee scaled by search radius (defaulting to 5 blocks if unknown) rather than per target. Skips the entire group without cost if mana is insufficient, and charges nothing for an empty group. Group multiplier follows server config.
logos.desc.damage-all.param.targets: Entity group to damage; only living creatures inside are affected.
logos.desc.damage-all.param.amount: Base damage dealt to each eligible target.
logos.desc.damage-all.param.element: Damage element; defaults to Physical. Governs damage properties and base cost.
logos.desc.damage-all.param.on-kill: Runs once for each creature killed by this damage; target is the slain creature and here is its center.
logos.desc.ignite-all.intro: Ignites an entire entity group at once.
logos.desc.ignite-all.note: Charges a flat group fee scaled by search radius (defaulting to 5 blocks if unknown) rather than per target. Skips the group without cost if mana is insufficient, and charges nothing for an empty group. Group multiplier follows server config.
logos.desc.ignite-all.param.targets: Entity group to ignite, including creatures, dropped items, and projectiles.
logos.desc.ignite-all.param.seconds: Burn duration for each target. Range: 0–60 s.
logos.desc.freeze-all.intro: Freezes an entire entity group at once.
logos.desc.freeze-all.note: Charges a flat group fee scaled by search radius (defaulting to 5 blocks if unknown) rather than per target. Skips the group without cost if mana is insufficient, and charges nothing for an empty group. Group multiplier follows server config.
logos.desc.freeze-all.param.targets: Entity group to freeze; only living creatures inside are affected.
logos.desc.freeze-all.param.seconds: Freeze duration for each target. Range: 0–30 s. Keeps whichever expiry time is later.
logos.desc.disarm.intro: Forces a target to drop one un-cursed piece of equipment, prioritizing held items.
logos.desc.equip.intro: Transfers a specific item from the caster's inventory into the first empty equipment slot on the target.
logos.desc.equip.param.target: Living creature or entity group to equip. Slots are checked in order: main hand, off hand, head, chest, legs, feet, never overwriting existing gear or filtering by item slot type. Targeting other players requires Affect players.
logos.desc.equip.param.item: Item registry ID or Registry Library item card to equip. Each equipped target consumes one matching item from the caster's inventory, preserving enchantments, durability, and custom data.
logos.desc.equip.note: Costs 8 mana and one matching item per equipped target, even in Creative mode. Skips targets with no empty slot, or when the caster is not a player or lacks the item, charging nothing and never creating items out of thin air.
logos.desc.disarm.note: Costs 8 mana per item dropped; charges nothing if the target holds no removable gear. Dropped items have a brief pickup delay.
logos.desc.disarm.param.target: Living creature or entity group to disarm. Checks main hand, off hand, head, chest, legs, and feet in order; armor with Curse of Binding cannot be dropped.
logos.desc.potion.intro: Applies a chosen potion effect to living targets.
logos.desc.potion.note: Continuous effects cost 0.8 mana per second per level; instant effects cost 6 mana per level.
logos.desc.potion.param.target: Living creature or entity group to affect; each target is affected and paid for individually.
logos.desc.potion.param.effect: Registry ID of the potion effect, such as minecraft:speed.
logos.desc.potion.param.seconds: Duration for continuous effects. Range: 0–600 s; unused by instant effects.
logos.desc.potion.param.level: Effect strength level, starting at level 1. Range: 1–10; default: 1.
logos.desc.resize.intro: Scales a creature up or down using Minecraft's scale attribute, resizing its model, hitbox, and eye height until the duration ends.
logos.desc.resize.note: Costs 2 mana per target plus 0.2 per second times (scale factor - 1), charging identically for doubling or halving size. Reapplying replaces the previous resize effect, and milk cures it.
logos.desc.resize.param.target: Living creature or entity group to resize; each target is scaled and paid for individually. Targeting other players requires Affect players.
logos.desc.resize.param.scale: Size multiplier from 1/16 to 16 (above 1 enlarges, below 1 shrinks, 1 restores normal size), snapped to 16 steps per doubling.
logos.desc.resize.param.seconds: Duration of the size change. Range: 0–600 s; default: 30 s.
logos.desc.water-walk.intro: Lets targets walk across fluid surfaces—water, lava, modded fluids, still, flowing, or waterlogged—treating the surface like solid ground.
logos.desc.water-walk.note: Costs 0.3 mana per second per target. Sneaking sinks into the fluid while standing up floats back to the surface, and landing from height still deals normal fall damage. Standing on lava does not burn the target, though falling beneath it still does. Milk cures the effect.
logos.desc.water-walk.param.target: Living creature or entity group granted fluid walking; each is affected and paid for individually.
logos.desc.water-walk.param.seconds: Effect duration. Range: 0–600 s; default: 60 s. Reapplying keeps whichever duration is longer.
logos.desc.possess.intro: Projects the caster's soul into a creature, letting standard movement, jump, melee attack, and right-click special skills (such as creeper explosions, enderman teleports, or skeleton shots) control its body. The caster's own body stays behind and takes any damage dealt to it.
logos.desc.possess.note: Costs target's current health / 5 * sqrt(seconds), or nothing when possessing one's own familiar. Sneak to leave early; moving more than 128 blocks from the caster's body also breaks possession. If the possessed creature dies, the caster takes damage equal to 25% of their max health.
logos.desc.possess.param.target: Creature to possess within 128 blocks; cannot target players, bosses, or creatures carrying riders.
logos.desc.possess.param.seconds: Possession duration. Range: 1–600 s; default: 30 s.
logos.desc.incarnate.intro: Transforms the caster into a chosen creature, adopting its size, eye height, max health, attack damage, armor, and speed, along with flight, water breathing, fire immunity, right-click skills (with an empty main hand for forms with hands), and species traits or weaknesses such as spider climbing, slow falling, lava walking, daylight burning, water sensitivity, or suffocating out of water. Inventory is preserved, and dying while incarnated is fatal.
logos.desc.incarnate.note: Costs the creature's max health / 5 * sqrt(seconds). Requires meeting the kill quota first (49 kills for normal creatures, 7 for bosses), shared with summon. Only configured humanoid forms keep item and hand use. Ends on timer expiry, via end-all or revert, or when the caster presses the Revert key (default V, free); logging out preserves the form.
logos.desc.incarnate.param.creature: Creature ID to become, such as zombie, bat, or modid:creature; cannot be a player or a Mana Lifeform.
logos.desc.incarnate.param.seconds: Incarnation duration. Range: 1–600 s; default: 30 s.
logos.desc.push.intro: Pushes targets away from a center position.
logos.desc.push.note: Costs 1.5 mana per unit of strength per target.
logos.desc.push.param.target: Entity or entity group to shove, including creatures and dropped items.
logos.desc.push.param.strength: Push force applied away from the repulsion center toward each target. Range: 0–4.
logos.desc.pull.intro: Pulls targets toward a center position, useful for gathering creatures or dropped items.
logos.desc.pull.note: Costs 1.5 mana per unit of strength per target.
logos.desc.pull.param.target: Entity or entity group to pull, including creatures and dropped items.
logos.desc.pull.param.strength: Pull force applied toward the attraction center; throttled near the center to reduce overshooting. Range: 0–4.
logos.desc.launch.intro: Launches targets straight upward into the air.
logos.desc.launch.note: Costs 1.5 mana per unit of strength per target.
logos.desc.launch.param.target: Entity or entity group to launch upward, including creatures and dropped items.
logos.desc.mark.intro: Inscribes a custom mark onto targets for later filtering, stack counting, or execution proofs.
logos.desc.mark.note: Costs 1 mana per stack added per target.
logos.desc.mark.param.target: Living creature or entity group to mark.
logos.desc.mark.param.mark: Custom mark name; subsequent checks or unmark calls must use the same name.
logos.desc.mark.param.stacks: Number of stacks added onto any existing stacks. Range: 1–99; default: 1.
logos.desc.unmark.intro: Removes a chosen custom mark from targets.
logos.desc.unmark.param.target: Living creature or entity group whose mark to clear.
logos.desc.unmark.param.mark: Name of the mark to remove, clearing all of its stacks.
logos.desc.execute.intro: Pronounces judgment over life and death using proven premises. Proven health bounds and status or mark checks inside a true if branch reduce execution cost.
logos.desc.execute.note: Base cost is 4 times the target's max health; proven health caps, statuses, and marks reduce this price. If a proof has become false at execution time, the paradox backlashes on the caster and ends the spell. Against an Alchemical Colossus, drains its mana to shut it down without triggering kill events.
logos.desc.execute.param.target: Single living target to execute; all proofs concerning this target are re-verified at the moment of execution.
logos.desc.execute.param.on-kill: Runs when execution kills the target; target is the slain creature and here is its center.
logos.desc.blink.intro: Teleports targets instantaneously to a destination, even across dimensions; defaults to the caster.
logos.desc.blink.note: Charges each target separately: 2 + 0.5 * distance mana within the same dimension, or a flat 22 mana across dimensions. Teleporting other players requires Affect players on the spell.
logos.desc.blink.param.pos: Destination position including dimension, such as a look-point, anchor, or in-dimension result. Searches nearby for safe footing if the exact spot is obstructed.
logos.desc.blink.param.target: Entity or entity group to teleport (every member of a group moves to the same spot); defaults to the caster.
logos.desc.summon.intro: Summons a loyal familiar bound to the caster, or forms a Mana Lifeform with its own mana pool.
logos.desc.summon.note: Normal familiars cost 2 * max health mana and last one Minecraft day. Mana Lifeforms persist long-term, require at least their level's minimum starting mana, and can cast spell pages placed in their core.
logos.desc.summon.param.creature: Registry ID of the creature to summon; normal creatures require meeting their kill quota first, while Mana Lifeforms do not.
logos.desc.summon.param.at: Spawn position for the familiar; defaults to 2 blocks ahead of here along aim.
logos.desc.summon.param.yield: Outputs this newly summoned familiar for subsequent actions, such as wiring it to glow; empty if summoning failed.
logos.desc.summon.param.name: Optional name assigned to the familiar so the familiar node can retrieve it later by name.
logos.desc.summon.param.hunt: Optional filter defining targets the familiar actively hunts; leave blank for default behavior.
logos.desc.summon.param.radius: Search and combat range used alongside Hunting filter; leave blank for the default radius.
logos.desc.summon.param.level: Mana Lifeform level. Range: 1–5; default: 1. Unused for normal familiars.
logos.desc.summon.param.mana: Starting mana poured into the Mana Lifeform's own pool; if blank, transfers as much remaining spell mana as fits up to its level cap. Unused for normal familiars.
logos.desc.dismiss.note: Costs no mana; any items carried or picked up by the dismissed familiar drop on the ground.
logos.desc.dismiss.param.target: Owned familiar or entity group to dismiss; defaults to the most recently summoned familiar. Never affects entities belonging to others.
logos.desc.gather.intro: Orders familiars to travel to a rally point, ignoring combat along the way.
logos.desc.gather.note: Costs 1 mana per familiar. New orders, combat, or distance limits may end a temporary wait, and a familiar gives up if the point is unreachable.
logos.desc.gather.param.familiar: Owned familiar or entity group to command; defaults to the most recently summoned familiar.
logos.desc.gather.param.to: Rally destination; defaults to the caster's position. Returns to following once reaching its owner, or waits temporarily at other locations.
logos.desc.stance.intro: Updates a familiar's hunting rules and a Mana Lifeform's combat role.
logos.desc.stance.note: Costs 2 mana per familiar. Role takes one of the listed valid role names as text.
logos.desc.stance.param.familiar: Owned familiar or entity group to update; defaults to the most recently summoned familiar.
logos.desc.stance.param.hunt: Active hunting filter; leave blank to keep the current rule.
logos.desc.stance.param.radius: Active hunt and pursuit radius; leave blank to keep the current range.
logos.desc.stance.param.role: Combat role for Mana Lifeforms only: auto (Natural), striker (Striker), guard (Guard), or support (Support). Leave blank to keep the current role.
logos.desc.sic.intro: Commands chosen familiars to attack a specific target immediately.
logos.desc.sic.param.familiar: Owned familiar or entity group carrying out the attack; defaults to the most recently summoned familiar.
logos.desc.taunt.intro: Makes targets attack only the chosen bait for a while, even when something else hits them; afterwards they go back to their own ways.
logos.desc.taunt.note: Costs 0.5 mana per creature per second. Familiars can't be taunted; the taunt ends early if the bait falls or gets more than 32 blocks away.
logos.desc.taunt.param.target: Creature to taunt; also accepts an entity group.
logos.desc.taunt.param.to: The bait the taunted creatures attack; defaults to the caster.
logos.desc.taunt.param.seconds: How long it lasts, 1 to 30 seconds, default 6.
logos.desc.anchor.intro: Sets a named anchor at a position for future spells to reference.
logos.desc.anchor.note: Consumes an Anchor Nail in Survival mode; extinguishes the spell if none are carried or the anchor limit is reached.
logos.desc.anchor.param.anchor: Name for the anchor; updates its position if an anchor with the same name already exists.
logos.desc.anchor.param.at: Position and dimension recorded by the anchor; defaults to here.
logos.desc.unanchor.intro: Removes a named anchor placed by the caster.
logos.desc.unanchor.note: Costs no mana; Anchor Nails are not refunded.
logos.desc.unanchor.param.anchor: Name of the anchor to delete; once removed, it can no longer be read.
logos.desc.move.intro: Commands a spell form from this cast to head toward a destination: constructs and fields glide there, projectiles steer toward it at their own speed and keep flying past, and beams relocate their origin there.
logos.desc.move.note: Costs 1 + 0.1 * distance mana. Moving a caster-following field leaves it fixed at the new destination.
logos.desc.move.param.construct: Form from this cast to move; connect 'this form', a form node's 'this form' output, or the construct's self node inside its events.
logos.desc.move.param.to: Destination position. Constructs trigger their On arrive event upon reaching it.
logos.desc.move.param.speed: Gliding speed for constructs and fields. Range: 0.01–2 blocks/tick; default: 0.2. Constructs carry standing entities along; unused by projectiles and beams.
logos.desc.halt.intro: Stops a spell form from this cast in place while its lifetime keeps ticking.
logos.desc.halt.note: Costs no mana. Constructs stop moving, fields stop following and stay put, projectiles hover in midair while still colliding, and beams lock their origin and aim instead of following gaze.
logos.desc.halt.param.construct: Form from this cast to halt.
logos.desc.turn.intro: Turns a spell form from this cast toward a new direction.
logos.desc.turn.note: Costs no mana. Projectiles redirect along the new bearing (restarting hovered ones), beams fix their aim instead of tracking gaze, constructs such as walls and disks rotate in place unless set to follow the caster's gaze, and directionless fields are unaffected.
logos.desc.turn.param.form: Form from this cast to turn.
logos.desc.turn.param.dir: New facing or travel direction, such as a toward, dir-of, or random-dir node.
logos.desc.disperse.intro: Immediately disperses a spell form created during this cast.
logos.desc.disperse.note: Costs no mana. Triggers the form's On expire event just as natural expiry does, enabling effects like bursting on recall. Only affects forms from this cast.
logos.desc.disperse.param.form: Form from this cast to disperse.
logos.desc.revert.intro: Ends an active incarnation, returning transformed players to their normal shape; defaults to reverting the caster.
logos.desc.revert.note: Free on the caster. Reverting another player requires Affect players on the spell and costs the remaining value of their incarnation: max health / 5 * (sqrt(total seconds) - sqrt(elapsed seconds)).
logos.desc.revert.param.target: Player or entity group to revert; non-incarnated targets are unaffected. Defaults to the caster.
logos.desc.end-all.intro: Extinguishes active spells within range, including those cast by others. Any active spell form inside the radius terminates its entire spell, ending all its distant forms, queued delays, and repeats at once.
logos.desc.end-all.note: Stops closest spells first, paying remaining mana + 2 per extinguished spell. Spells too costly to afford are skipped while search continues for cheaper ones, making freshly cast grand spells harder to quell than nearly spent ones. Extinguished spells do not trigger On expire. Affects the caster's own other spells, Mana Lifeforms, Alchemical Colossi, and Spell Emitters; affecting other players' spells requires Affect players. Previously applied effects like time-stop, shields, marks, and potions remain.
logos.desc.end-all.param.at: Center of the dispelling radius; defaults to here.
logos.desc.end-all.param.radius: Maximum distance from Center within which active spell forms are detected. Range: up to 32 blocks; default: 6 blocks.
logos.desc.copy.intro: Duplicates projectiles in flight and fans the copies outward.
logos.desc.copy.note: Costs 3 mana per copy created. Copies cannot be copied again, and copied arrows or tridents cannot be picked up.
logos.desc.copy.param.target: Projectile or entity group to duplicate; skips entities that cannot be copied or are already copies.
logos.desc.copy.param.count: Number of extra copies to create while keeping the original projectile intact. Range: 0–8.
logos.desc.copy.param.spread: Angular step deflecting successive copies left and right. Range: 0–90 degrees; default: 10 degrees.
logos.desc.phantasm.intro: Displays cosmetic particles at a location for visual accents or ritual cues.
logos.desc.phantasm.note: Costs 0.02 mana per particle. Purely cosmetic, dealing no damage and applying no entity effects.
logos.desc.phantasm.param.particle: Registry ID of the particle type to spawn.
logos.desc.phantasm.param.at: Center where particles appear; defaults to here.
logos.desc.phantasm.param.count: Number of particles spawned per call. Range: 1–64 (up to server cap); default: 1.
logos.desc.phantasm.param.spread: Random scatter scale in blocks; governs spread width rather than a strict outer boundary. Range: 0–8 blocks; default: 0.
logos.desc.echo.intro: Displays a value to the caster in chat for inspecting spell behavior.
logos.desc.echo.param.value: Any number, entity, position, or other value to display without modifying it.
logos.desc.toggle-state.intro: Cycles a block state property to its next allowed value.
logos.desc.toggle-state.note: Costs 5 mana per block modified; changes are permanent rather than temporary illusions.
logos.desc.toggle-state.param.block: Block position or block group to cycle.
logos.desc.toggle-state.param.property: Vanilla block state property name such as facing, half, or lit; leave blank to cycle the block's first property.
logos.desc.use-block.intro: Simulates a right-click interaction on blocks—operating buttons, levers, doors, trapdoors, or repeaters from afar without opening containers like chests or furnaces.
logos.desc.use-block.note: Costs 2 mana each time an interaction succeeds, and nothing if nothing happens. Clicks from the face toward the caster; casts from a Spell Emitter always use an empty hand.
logos.desc.use-block.param.block: Block position or block group to activate.
logos.desc.use-block.param.item: Item used for the interaction via a Registry Library card or item ID; leave blank for an empty hand. Must be present in the caster's inventory; consumed items are deducted and returned items like empty buckets or glass bottles go back into the inventory.
logos.desc.grow.intro: Accelerates growth of crops, plants, and baby creatures in an area.
logos.desc.grow.note: Advances crop age by one stage, applies bonemeal-like growth to other growable plants, and speeds up baby creatures' aging. Costs 2 mana per target actually affected, subject to block edit permissions.
logos.desc.grow.param.at: Center block position or block group around which growth is applied.
logos.desc.grow.param.radius: Effect radius around each center. Range: 0–6 blocks; default: 1 block.
logos.desc.time-skip.intro: Speeds time forward in the caster's current dimension, accelerating smoothly up to a cap before easing to a halt. In dimensions with day-night cycles, sun, moon, clouds, and random ticks all accelerate; dimensions without day-night cycles such as the Nether and the End speed up only random ticks.
logos.desc.time-skip.note: Pays as time advances at 4 mana per second of normal time skipped, stopping automatically if mana runs dry (a Supreme Principle page can skip roughly 53 minutes). Only one time-skip may run per clock at a time; overlapping casts are refused at no cost. Maximum daylight rate and random-tick multiplier follow server config (defaulting to 720x and 300x), and random ticks speed up only in the casting dimension. Normal flow resumes on completion, dispelling, or server shutdown.
logos.desc.time-skip.param.seconds: Duration of normal-speed time to advance (0 disables the effect). Range: 0–36000 s.
logos.desc.world-weather.intro: Changes the global weather to clear, rain, or thunder across all weather-bearing dimensions until natural weather takes over again after the duration ends.
logos.desc.world-weather.note: Charges per weather change regardless of duration: 100 mana for clear or rain, 200 mana for thunder. Global weather cannot force snow worldwide—use area weather for snow—and fails without cost in dimensions without weather such as the Nether or the End.
logos.desc.world-weather.param.weather: Target global weather: Clear, Rain, or Thunder. In cold biomes, rain falls as snow as in vanilla.
logos.desc.world-weather.param.seconds: Minimum duration of the new weather before natural changes resume. Range: 1–1200 s; default: 600 s.
logos.desc.weather.intro: Overrides weather inside an infinite-height cylindrical zone around a center without disturbing outside weather. Localized rain puts out fire, hydrates farmland, fills cauldrons, boosts lightning damage, and shifts nearby sky, fog, and rain sounds cleanly when entering or leaving.
logos.desc.weather.note: Deploys for 10 mana and drains 0.02 * radius^2 mana per second (doubled for thunder), dispersing when mana runs out. Snow and rain accumulate faster inside the zone than in natural weather, and thunder strikes randomly within it. Fails without cost in dimensions without weather such as the Nether or the End; when zones overlap, the newest cast takes precedence.
logos.desc.weather.param.weather: Weather inside the zone: Clear prevents rain even during global storms; Rain falls as snow in cold biomes; Thunder brings rain and lightning strikes; Snow forces snowfall, snow layers, and freezing water in any biome.
logos.desc.weather.param.at: Horizontal center of the vertical weather cylinder; defaults to here.
logos.desc.weather.param.radius: Zone radius (upkeep scales with area). Range: 1–48 blocks; default: 8 blocks.
logos.desc.weather.param.life: Maximum duration of the weather zone. Range: 1–600 s; default: 30 s.
logos.desc.weather.param.follow: Makes the weather zone continuously follow the caster.
logos.desc.decay.intro: Withers plants and regresses ageable creatures toward infancy within an area.
logos.desc.decay.note: Lowers crop age by one stage, breaks eligible plants or leaves with standard drops, and ages creatures backward toward babies. Costs 2 mana per target actually affected, subject to block edit permissions.
logos.desc.decay.param.at: Center block position or block group around which decay is applied.
logos.desc.decay.param.radius: Effect radius around each center. Range: 0–6 blocks; default: 1 block.
logos.desc.break-block.intro: Breaks targeted blocks and drops their normal loot.
logos.desc.break-block.note: Costs 2 + 2 * block hardness mana per block broken, subject to block edit permissions.
logos.desc.break-block.param.block: Block position or block group to break; unbreakable blocks are skipped.
logos.desc.lightning.intro: Calls down a natural lightning bolt at a target position, igniting nearby blocks, harming creatures within roughly 3 blocks, charging creepers, and deoxidizing copper.
logos.desc.lightning.note: Costs 50 mana per bolt, reduced to 40 if raining at the strike point or 20 during thunder—pair with area weather to summon storms first. Checks area weather at the strike point (ignoring clear and snow) before falling back to open-sky world weather in that column. Skips other players unless Affect players is enabled, while fire ignition follows vanilla rules. Skips protected positions without cost.
logos.desc.lightning.param.at: Strike position or block group; each position summons and pays for its own bolt.
logos.desc.set-fire.intro: Places fire at a target position.
logos.desc.set-fire.note: Costs 2 mana per fire actually lit, subject to placement rules and edit permissions.
logos.desc.set-fire.param.block: Target position or block group; ignites air blocks directly or attempts to place fire atop solid blocks.
logos.desc.infuse-block.intro: Pours mana from this cast into mana-accepting blocks such as Alchemy Tables or emitters.
logos.desc.infuse-block.note: Costs 1.1 mana per 1 mana infused. Transfers only what the block can still store; skips full, incompatible, or protected blocks at no cost.
logos.desc.infuse-block.param.at: Target block position or block group (either half of an Alchemy Table works); each position is infused and paid for individually.
logos.desc.infuse-block.param.amount: Maximum mana transferred to each block; excess beyond capacity is not spent.
logos.desc.if.intro: Chooses one of two action branches based on a proposition. Qualifying conditions inside the true branch also act as proofs for subsequent executions.
logos.desc.if.note: Costs 0.5 mana; executes only one of the two branches.
logos.desc.if.param.cond: Proposition tested to decide which branch runs.
logos.desc.if.param.then: Action executed when the proposition holds true.
logos.desc.if.param.else: Optional action executed when the proposition is false; may be left unwired.
logos.desc.switch.intro: Selects and executes a single action branch by numeric index.
logos.desc.switch.note: Costs 0.5 mana. Adjust the branch count in the node's Branch count option; unwired branches do nothing.
logos.desc.switch.param.index: Zero-based branch index, rounded to the nearest integer; pair with whole-number random, round, or wave.
logos.desc.switch.param.branch: Action executed when the rounded index equals this branch's number.
logos.desc.switch.param.on-other: Fallback action run when the index is below 0, past the last branch, or not a valid number; inherits the current here, target, and branch context.
logos.desc.each.intro: Runs an action sequentially for every eligible entity in an entity group.
logos.desc.each.note: Costs 0.5 mana before each iteration; inner actions pay their own costs.
logos.desc.each.param.targets: Entity group to iterate over; invalid or disallowed entities are skipped.
logos.desc.each.param.body: Action run per entity; target is set to that entity and here is its center.
logos.desc.each-block.intro: Runs an action sequentially for every block position in a block group.
logos.desc.each-block.note: Costs 0.5 mana per block position; inner actions pay their own costs.
logos.desc.each-block.param.blocks: Set of block positions to iterate over.
logos.desc.each-block.param.body: Action run per block position; here is set to the block's center without replacing target.
logos.desc.repeat.intro: Repeats a sequence of actions a set number of times, either immediately or on a timed interval.
logos.desc.repeat.note: Costs 1 mana per iteration plus inner action costs; ending the spell cancels any remaining timed iterations.
logos.desc.repeat.param.times: Number of repetitions; values below 0 run zero times, capped by server config.
logos.desc.repeat.param.every: Delay between iterations; default: 0 (runs immediately in sequence). Range: 0–10 s.
logos.desc.repeat.param.body: Action repeated each iteration; read the loop index with the i context node (starting from 0).
logos.desc.delay.intro: Waits for a chosen duration before running the connected action.
logos.desc.delay.note: Costs 0.5 mana to schedule plus inner action costs; canceled if the spell ends beforehand.
logos.desc.delay.param.seconds: Wait time before execution. Range: 0–30 s.
logos.desc.delay.param.body: Action run after the delay; keeps the scheduling event's context, though un-remembered value nodes re-evaluate when the delayed action runs.
logos.desc.recurse.intro: Re-executes the entire spell body from the current context, creating tail/loop recursion.
