logos.desc.recurse.note: Costs 3 mana per recursion and increments recursion depth by 1, ending the spell if depth exceeds the server cap. Does not inject new mana; all depths share the cast's pool.
logos.desc.stop.intro: Immediately extinguishes this spell, canceling any downstream actions, pending delays, and active forms.
logos.desc.stop.note: Costs no mana; execution halts immediately even if downstream flow ports are connected.
logos.desc.let.intro: Evaluates a value once when flow reaches this node and remembers it for all subsequent steps, ideal for locking a position or target at cast time.
logos.desc.let.note: Ordinary value nodes re-evaluate on every read; let prevents delayed or repeated steps from drifting if gaze or positions change later.
logos.desc.let.param.kind: Type of value to remember (Entity, Entities, Position, Direction, or Number); changes the node's input and output types.
logos.desc.let.param.value: Input value evaluated once and stored at this point in the flow.
logos.desc.let.param.remembered: Outputs the stored value without re-evaluating the original input.
logos.desc.+.intro: Adds two or more numbers together.
logos.desc.+.param.argument-count: Sets how many number inputs are summed, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.+.param.x: One number included in the sum.
logos.desc.*.intro: Multiplies two or more numbers together.
logos.desc.*.param.argument-count: Sets how many number inputs are multiplied, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.*.param.x: One number included in the product.
logos.desc.min.intro: Finds the smallest value among multiple numbers.
logos.desc.min.result: Smallest value among all connected numbers.
logos.desc.min.param.argument-count: Sets how many number inputs are compared, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.min.param.x: One number included in the minimum comparison.
logos.desc.max.intro: Finds the largest value among multiple numbers.
logos.desc.max.result: Largest value among all connected numbers.
logos.desc.max.param.argument-count: Sets how many number inputs are compared, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.max.param.x: One number included in the maximum comparison.
logos.desc./.result: Quotient of Dividend divided by Divisor; returns 0 when Divisor is 0.
logos.desc.<.intro: Tests whether the left number is strictly less than the right number.
logos.desc.<.result: True if Left value < Right value; false otherwise.
logos.desc.>.intro: Tests whether the left number is strictly greater than the right number.
logos.desc.>.result: True if Left value > Right value; false otherwise.
logos.desc.<=.intro: Tests whether the left number is less than or equal to the right number.
logos.desc.<=.result: True if Left value <= Right value; false otherwise.
logos.desc.>=.intro: Tests whether the left number is greater than or equal to the right number.
logos.desc.>=.result: True if Left value >= Right value; false otherwise.
logos.desc.=.intro: Tests whether two numbers are equal.
logos.desc.=.result: True if the two numbers match within tolerance; false otherwise.
logos.desc.=.note: Equality allows a floating-point tolerance smaller than one part in a billion.
logos.desc.hp.intro: Reads a living creature's current health.
logos.desc.hp.param.entity: Living creature to inspect; returns 0 if empty or not a living creature.
logos.desc.max-hp.intro: Reads a living creature's maximum health.
logos.desc.max-hp.param.entity: Living creature to inspect; returns 0 if empty or not a living creature.
logos.desc.hp-ratio.intro: Reads a creature's current health as a fraction of its max health.
logos.desc.hp-ratio.result: Current health divided by max health, typically 0–1 (for example, 0.25 at quarter health).
logos.desc.hp-ratio.param.entity: Living creature to inspect; returns 0 if empty or not a living creature.
logos.desc.missing-hp.intro: Reads how much health a creature has lost below its maximum.
logos.desc.missing-hp.param.entity: Living creature to inspect; returns 0 if empty or not a living creature.
logos.desc.stacks.intro: Reads the stack count of a custom mark, or remaining seconds of burning or freezing.
logos.desc.stacks.result: Current stack count or remaining seconds; returns 0 if absent.
logos.desc.stacks.param.status: Mark or status to query: custom marks return stack count, while burning and freezing return remaining seconds.
logos.desc.distance.intro: Measures the straight-line distance between two positions.
logos.desc.distance.result: Euclidean 3D distance in blocks; compares raw coordinates without dimensional scaling.
logos.desc.mix.intro: Interpolates linearly between two numbers: Ratio 0 returns Value A, 1 returns Value B, and 0.5 returns their midpoint.
logos.desc.mix.result: Value A + (Value B - Value A) * Ratio. Ratios below 0 or above 1 extrapolate past the endpoints along the same line.
logos.desc.mix.param.alpha: Interpolation ratio between Value A and Value B; pair with random, wave, or loop index i for gradients, and pass through clamp if bounded output is needed.
logos.desc.round.intro: Rounds a number to an integer.
logos.desc.round.result: Integer produced according to the chosen rounding mode.
logos.desc.round.param.mode: Nearest rounds half away from zero (2.5 -> 3, -2.5 -> -3); Round up takes the ceiling integer; Round down takes the floor integer.
logos.desc.clamp.intro: Restricts a number to stay between a lower and an upper bound.
logos.desc.clamp.result: Lower bound if below minimum, Upper bound if above maximum, or the original value when inside range.
logos.desc.clamp.param.min: Minimum allowed value; default: 0. Swaps automatically with Upper bound if Lower bound is greater.
logos.desc.choose.intro: Selects one value from several candidates by index. All candidates must share the selected Value type (Number, Position, Direction, Entity, or Entities).
logos.desc.choose.result: The chosen candidate matching the selected type; only the selected candidate is evaluated.
logos.desc.choose.param.kind: Type shared by all candidates and the output; changing it updates all candidate ports and the result port.
logos.desc.choose.param.index: Zero-based option index, rounded to the nearest integer. Clamps to the nearest end unless Wrap around is enabled.
logos.desc.choose.param.value: One candidate option; its number corresponds to its selection index.
logos.desc.choose.param.wrap: Wraps out-of-range indices cyclically around the candidate list (with 3 options, index 3 selects 0 and -1 selects 2), useful for rotating choices with loop index i.
logos.desc.life-of.intro: Reads what fraction of its lifetime a spell form has elapsed.
logos.desc.life-of.result: A value from 0 to 1, where 0 is freshly deployed and 1 is expired (already-dispersed forms return 1).
logos.desc.life-of.param.form: Form to inspect: connect 'this form' inside form events, or a form node's 'this form' output afterward.
logos.desc.life-of.note: Costs no mana. Pairing this with mix or wave lets effects scale across a form's lifetime, such as a projectile growing stronger over distance.
logos.desc.wave.intro: Generates a periodic wave from an input number, repeating one full cycle each period.
logos.desc.wave.result: Value oscillating between -Amplitude and +Amplitude. Waves start at 0 rising toward their peak at one-quarter period (square waves start at +Amplitude). Pass through mix or clamp if a 0–1 range is desired.
logos.desc.wave.param.x: Input driving the wave, such as loop index, distance, or mana remaining.
logos.desc.wave.param.shape: Sine oscillates smoothly; Triangle rises and falls linearly; Sawtooth ramps up steadily then resets; Square alternates between +Amplitude and -Amplitude.
logos.desc.wave.param.period: Input span for one full cycle; default: 1. Returns 0 when Period is 0.
logos.desc.wave.param.amp: Peak height of the wave; default: 1. Negative amplitudes invert the wave vertically.
logos.desc.wave.param.phase: Cycles to shift the wave forward; default: 0 (0.25 advances by a quarter cycle).
logos.desc.count.intro: Counts members currently stored in an entity group without re-searching the world.
logos.desc.count.result: Number of entities in the group.
logos.desc.block-count.intro: Counts positions currently stored in a block group without re-searching the world.
logos.desc.block-count.result: Number of block positions in the group.
logos.desc.mana-left.intro: Reads the mana remaining in this cast's shared spell pool.
logos.desc.mana-left.result: Remaining mana budget for the current cast (not the caster's personal mana pool).
logos.desc.depth.intro: Reads the current recursion depth of this spell cast.
logos.desc.depth.result: Starts at 0 on initial invocation and increments by 1 on each recurse.
logos.desc.random.intro: Generates a fresh random number on each evaluation.
logos.desc.random.result: Random value between Lower bound and Upper bound; store it with let if the same roll must be reused.
logos.desc.random.param.max: Upper limit of the range; default: 1. Excluded in decimal mode.
logos.desc.random.param.min: Lower limit of the range; default: 0. Swaps with Upper bound if greater.
logos.desc.random.param.whole: Generates integers only, inclusive of both bounds (so 1 and 6 simulates a six-sided die); falls back to the nearest integer if none lies strictly between the bounds.
logos.desc.and.intro: Tests whether all connected propositions are true.
logos.desc.and.result: True when every proposition holds; inside a true if branch, qualifying propositions combine into execution proofs.
logos.desc.and.param.argument-count: Sets how many propositions are tested, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.and.param.p: One proposition that must hold for the combined result to be true.
logos.desc.or.intro: Tests whether at least one connected proposition is true.
logos.desc.or.result: True when any proposition holds; an 'or' combination itself grants no execution proofs.
logos.desc.or.param.argument-count: Sets how many propositions are tested, adding or removing input ports accordingly.
logos.desc.or.param.p: One proposition capable of making the combined result true.
logos.desc.not.result: Inverted truth value; negation does not grant execution proofs.
logos.desc.not.param.p: Proposition to invert (true becomes false, false becomes true).
logos.desc.has.intro: Tests whether an entity currently has a given status or custom mark.
logos.desc.has.result: True if the status or mark is active on the entity.
logos.desc.has.param.status: Status or mark to check: burning, frozen, or a custom mark name matching the one inscribed with mark.
logos.desc.is.intro: Tests whether an entity satisfies a filter.
logos.desc.is.result: True if the entity exists and matches the filter.
logos.desc.is.param.entity: Entity to test; false if empty.
logos.desc.is.param.filter: Entity kind, registry ID, tag, or combined filter to match against.
logos.desc.block-is.intro: Tests whether the block at a position satisfies a filter.
logos.desc.block-is.result: True if the block matches the filter.
logos.desc.block-is.param.filter: Block registry ID or #tag filter to match against.
logos.desc.is-air.intro: Tests whether a block position is air.
logos.desc.is-air.result: True only for air blocks; passable non-air blocks such as tall grass return false.
logos.desc.alive.intro: Tests whether a reference points to a living, surviving creature.
logos.desc.alive.result: True if the entity exists, is a living creature, and is still alive.
logos.desc.alive.param.entity: Entity to check; non-living entities like dropped items and projectiles return false.
logos.desc.caster.intro: Provides the entity casting this spell.
logos.desc.caster.result: Current caster: the player for wand casts, a Mana Lifeform itself when cast from its core, or a proxy caster for emitters.
logos.desc.caster.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.target.intro: Provides the entity targeted by the current event or loop.
logos.desc.target.result: Current entity in hit, enter, kill, each, or passive-trigger contexts; does not automatically search for the nearest enemy.
logos.desc.target.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.here.intro: Provides the position and dimension of the current execution context.
logos.desc.here.result: Context-dependent location such as a struck entity's center, block impact spot, field center, or ray endpoint; not always fixed at the caster's feet.
logos.desc.here.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.aim.intro: Provides the direction vector of the current execution context.
logos.desc.aim.result: Current aim direction, usually originating from the cast direction and overridden inside contexts like split branches or construct pass events.
logos.desc.aim.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.up.intro: Provides the fixed upward unit direction.
logos.desc.up.result: Straight-up direction vector, unaffected by view pitch or yaw.
logos.desc.up.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.down.intro: Provides the fixed downward unit direction.
logos.desc.down.result: Straight-down direction vector, unaffected by view pitch or yaw.
logos.desc.down.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.self.intro: Provides the construct entity or wrapped creature triggering the current event.
logos.desc.self.result: Inside construct events, outputs the construct entity (usable with move or halt); inside mana wrap events, outputs the creature wearing the wrap.
logos.desc.self.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.form.intro: Provides the spell form triggering the current event: projectile, beam, vein, construct, field, or mana wrap.
logos.desc.form.result: Active form inside form events, usable with life-of, move, halt, or disperse; nested non-form events inside it inherit the outer form.
logos.desc.form.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context. To reference a form after creating it, wire its 'this form' output port instead.
logos.desc.i.intro: Provides the current iteration index inside a repeat loop.
logos.desc.i.result: Zero-based iteration counter inside repeat (0 on the first pass, 1 on the second).
logos.desc.i.note: Takes no inputs; value comes from the active execution context.
logos.desc.^.intro: Reads one of the caster's saved anchors as a world position.
logos.desc.^.result: Saved position and dimension of that anchor for blink, fields, or other position slots.
logos.desc.^.note: Set anchors using an Anchor Nail or the anchor rune; if the named anchor is missing at runtime, the spell ends.
logos.desc.^.param.anchor: Name of the saved anchor to look up; must belong to the caster.
logos.desc.imbue.intro: Winds an active spell wrap around a creature's main hand so attacks and swings with that hand trigger spell events. Bound to the hand rather than a specific item, so it persists when switching weapons or fighting bare-handed.
logos.desc.imbue.note: Deploys for 6 mana and costs 0.5 mana per pulse (every 0.5 s by default). Runes inside its events still draw from the spell's mana pool, and the wrap ends early if mana runs out. Only one wrap may be active per hand; casting a new one replaces the old. Adds no direct damage on its own. Inside its events, self refers to the wrapped wielder, while effects count as the caster's.
logos.desc.imbue.param.target: Living creature whose main hand receives the wrap; defaults to the caster.
logos.desc.imbue.param.life: Maximum duration of the wrap. Range: 0.05–3600 s; default: 10 s.
logos.desc.imbue.param.every: Interval between pulse events. Range: 0.05–10 s; default: 0.5 s.
logos.desc.imbue.param.on-hit: Runs when the wrapped main hand lands a melee blow charged to at least 90% (always triggers for mobs), or when a fully drawn arrow or thrown trident loosed by that hand hits; target is the struck entity and here is the contact point.
logos.desc.imbue.param.on-swing: Runs when a player swings the wrapped main hand at 90% charge or higher (hit or miss), or when a mob lands a melee hit; here is the wielder's eyes and aim is their look direction.
logos.desc.imbue.param.on-kill: Runs when a strike from the wrapped hand (including effects triggered by On hit) kills the target; target is the slain entity and here is its center.
logos.desc.imbue.param.on-tick: Runs once per pulse; here is the wielder's center and aim is their look direction.
logos.desc.imbue.param.on-expire: Runs when the wrap expires, is replaced by a new wrap, or ends because the wielder died or left the dimension; here is the wielder's last position. Not triggered if the entire spell ends.
logos.desc.imbue.param.yield: Outputs this mana wrap form for subsequent actions, such as life-of; inside its own events, use the 'this form' context node instead.
logos.desc.switch.param.argument-count: Sets the number of action branches, adding or removing branch output ports accordingly.
logos.desc.choose.param.argument-count: Sets how many candidate options are offered, adding or removing option input ports accordingly.
